projection_policy.source_digest: each non-empty source entry is sent through one source-digest semantic projection from its own source closure; a successful projection enters Reader and Home, while failure or ambiguity remains Audit-only
projection_policy.source_direct_audit: explicit source-direct-audit requests compile one source closure for Audit/coverage only and never enter Reader, Home, or released publication
projection_policy.quality_case: a source may participate in zero or more quality-case projections; each projection has its own frozen question, page_type, route, lineage and five-dimensional gate

defaults.route: source-digest for every non-empty entry; selected_source_paths must equal the one-source closure; source-direct-audit is explicit only; quality-case Reader selected_source_paths must be proven by actual embedding top-k and consumed by Qwen
defaults.lineage: every Reader answer and axis points to Claim/block/hash/locator
defaults.oracle: source-digest success requires a typed Reader page and Audit/coverage/RenderLedger; source-direct-audit requires reader_eligible=false and Audit/coverage/RenderLedger; known_empty and any failure remain Audit-only; no raw/full-source fallback
